definitions.gloss: disease (personified as a demon); the grip of illness
definitions.explanation: Serious illness spoken of as an evil force that attacks a person. A literary word, common in news and obituaries.

examples.japanese: {病魔|びょうま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧。
{病魔|びょうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧。
examples.english: A writer struck down by illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{病魔|びょうま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}い→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{続|つづ}けた→書き続ける：29433_kakitsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: Though he fought illness for many years, he kept writing to the very end.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{病|びょう} (illness) + ⟦{魔|ま}→魔：19358_ma⟧ (demon).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病魔|びょうま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧ (to fight a serious illness)
- {病魔|びょうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{侵|おか}される→侵す：19534_okasu⟧ (to be stricken by disease)
- {病魔|びょうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ (to be struck down by illness)
- {病魔|びょうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{勝|か}つ→打ち勝つ：12768_uchikatsu⟧ (to overcome an illness)

REGISTER:
Literary and dramatic; used of grave illnesses, not colds. Everyday speech says ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧.
